log: 10 Nov 2026 · System redesign (Claude Code) — the board moved from one hand-edited HTML file to a small system: curated data in data/jobs.json (schema-checked on every push), a real search engine (MiniSearch: ranked, typo-tolerant, with operators such as is:open, in:japan, due:30d), and two scheduled GitHub Actions that run on GitHub's own network — one verifies every tracked link, one pulls candidate postings from job-board feeds into a Discover tab for review. Entries are now classed by what they are (a specific opening, or a lead to pursue) and their state is derived from the data, so a passed deadline moves an entry out of Open automatically. As part of that reclassification, CCRS Singapore and KAUST are listed as leads (neither has a specific call open), and the real postings that had been sitting among the leads — UC Irvine, MBZUAI, Argonne, NTU, Columbia LDEO — are now under Open. No opening was added or rescored.

6 Nov 2026 · Live Openings link sweep (Claude Code) — Rona reported CCRS Singapore's link resolved to a logo image, not a page. Checked all 6 Live Openings links: **CCRS** fixed → their actual Careers & Internships page (ccrs.weather.gov.sg), with a real contact email for speculative CVs. **Columbia Lamont-Doherty** — the old requisition link couldn't be verified as live, swapped to LDEO's own postdoc page; found that LDEO's general Earth/Environmental/Climate Sciences fellowship closes TODAY (broader scope, worth knowing even if not an exact fit) and added the project PI's direct contact (Prof. Robert Pincus). **KAUST** — replaced a vague 'verify research fit' status with real program detail: the KGFP Call 2027 Stage 1 window already closed 1 Oct, Stage 2 is invitation-only, and the 'rolling' tag actually refers to a separate, non-fellowship postdoc track; link swapped to the fellowship's own portal. **JSPS** — tightened the link to the Standard program's specific page rather than a shorter, less precise path (already submitted, so low urgency, but cheap to fix). **Gothenburg** and **TU Delft EuRadCA** checked — already point to stable general portals or were already flagged appropriately; no change needed.

6 Nov 2026 · Structure change (Claude Code) — Rona asked for fresh/new items at the top and expired ones moved out of Live Openings into Resources & Leads. Added an `added` date to every entry and made it the primary sort (newest first, score as tiebreaker) in both tabs; Refresh-button results now stamp today's date so they always surface first. Reclassified 8 items whose deadline closed without ever being pursued — MSCA-PF, ETH Zurich, ICTP C3S, ICTP CLOSER, KIT/HITS, GFZ, Penn State, Exeter — from shortlist/watch to lead tier, so they now live in Resources & Leads instead of cluttering the live board; their status text (already honest about being closed/not-pursued) was left as-is. Live Openings is now a clean 6: CCRS Singapore, TU Delft EuRadCA, JSPS, KAUST, Gothenburg, Columbia Lamont — all either rolling/open or already submitted. Resources & Leads holds 21, freshest (MBZUAI, 5 Nov) first.

6 Nov 2026 · Link audit (Claude Code) — Rona reported recently-added links showing 'no longer available.' Checked each one individually: **UC Irvine** and **MBZUAI** links were secondary mirror postings, not the real application portals — fixed to UCI's own Recruit page (JPF10438) and MBZUAI's own careers site. **UCAR C&GC**'s Workday listing genuinely closed on its 17 Oct deadline and Workday pulled it — that's expected platform behaviour, not a bad link; swapped to the program's stable recruitment page. **Argonne**'s DOE-ASR mirror was stale — swapped to a fresher, currently-posted Workday req for a closely-related AERIS S2S role. **NUS**'s listing looks genuinely expired (its own posted date is Dec 2025) — no better link found, flagged honestly with the project/institute context for a fresh search instead. **NTU**'s link (apply by direct email) and **Stanford**'s AGU listing were confirmed fine as-is; Stanford's status now also carries a direct PI email (Da Yang) as a fallback since the listing is closed anyway. **TU Delft EuRadCA** (already submitted) was flagged next — its posting now shows expired too, but no genuine mirror/fix exists since the application was already in; status updated to say this is expected post-submission behaviour, with Dr. Marc Schleiss's contact added as a reference. Lesson for future scans: prefer an institution's own careers portal over aggregator/mirror sites when one is available, since mirrors go stale faster and less predictably; and a submitted item's ad disappearing is normal, not a defect to chase.

5 Nov 2026 · Scan (Claude Code) — board hadn't been touched since 30 Sep (5 weeks). Deadline audit: Stanford Thompson Fellowship and UCAR C&GC both closed since last scan — flagged for confirmation rather than assumed either way (Stanford's own sources even disagree on the date, 15 Sep vs 1 Oct — noted honestly, moot now either way). UC Irvine's real deadline turned out to be 31 Dec (two-stage review: 14 Oct priority date already passed, late applications considered only if still unfilled) — corrected from the earlier 'unverified ~14 Oct' note; the original listing has a typo in its deadline time worth double-checking directly. New lead: MBZUAI (Abu Dhabi) — Postdoctoral Researcher, AI for Weather Forecasting (ensemble DL, UQ, data assimilation) — added, but sources genuinely conflict on its deadline (5 Nov/6 Nov/6 Dec/31 Dec all seen); verify on MBZUAI's own site before anything else. WebFetch still egress-blocked; next scan 12 Nov.

30 Sep 2026 · Weekly scan (Claude Code) — deadline audit vs 30 Sep: no tracked-item deadlines cross today (MSCA-PF/ETH/KIT/Gothenburg/ICTP/GFZ/Penn State/Exeter all already closed from prior audits). WebSearch sweep surfaced four genuine new leads, all verified against their own postings (not just snippets): ⚠ **Stanford Thompson Fellowship** (Convection & Climate group, explicit MJO + ML focus) — deadline is TOMORROW, 1 Oct, added as urgent though there's no time to prepare a tailored application; **Columbia LDEO** — South Asia monsoon Low-Pressure Systems, open until filled, strong India-monsoon fit; **UC Irvine** (Magnusdottir group) — S2S/seasonal prediction, ML, ocean-atmosphere; **UCAR C&GC Fellowship** — self-directed NCAR fellowship, closes 16 Oct, needs a host mentor first. All four added as leads (score null) per the never-auto-score rule. WebFetch still egress-blocked; next scan 7 Oct.

15 Sep 2026 · China lead follow-up (Claude Code) — Rona forwarded a third-party consultancy flyer ("MP Consultant", WhatsApp/Gmail contact) advertising China PhD/postdoc programmes. Treated as an unverified tip, not a source — none of its specific program names or 'active intake' claims were taken at face value; every institution's official pages were checked directly instead. Half the flyer's list (CSC, CAS-ANSO, UCAS, USTC) is PhD-level, not relevant. Of the postdoc items: confirmed CAS PIFI is real, ¥200k/yr, 1–2 yr, applications open year-round via pifi.cas.cn — but critically it does NOT take direct applications; a CAS host must apply on the candidate's behalf. Folded into the existing IAP-CAS Beijing lead (Prof. Lin Wang) as its named funding mechanism — the PI contact step just became the actual bottleneck, not a nice-to-have. Peking Univ., Fudan, Shuimu Tsinghua and Westlake postdoc programmes were checked but no monsoon/radar/ML-relevant group or opening was identified — not added, generic institutional pages only. No fee, WhatsApp contact, or paid consultancy is needed for any of this — every programme above has a free, official application portal. Next scan 22 Sep.

10 Sep 2026 · Outcome update (Rona) — MSCA-PF @ TU Delft (closed 10 Sep) and ETH Zurich (closed 1 Sep) were **not** submitted; both moved to watch as missed. **JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship — submitted ✔** (moved to submitted). Two of the three portfolio deliverables from Aug/Sep lapsed, but the JSPS application is in — its 205 MHz-radar / MU-radar host fit (Kyoto RISH) was the strongest continuity story on the board, and it's now live.

10 Sep 2026 · Weekly scan (Claude Code) — ⚠ TODAY is the MSCA-PF @ TU Delft portal close (10 Sep); status flagged for confirmation since submission can't be verified from here. WebSearch sweep found no new confirmed-open postings: an 'MIT postdoc in tropical climate + ML' hit turned out to be an existing group member's bio (Shuchang Liu, O'Gorman/POG group), not a live vacancy — not added, per the never-assume rule. All other tracked deadlines (KIT/HITS, Gothenburg, ICTP, GFZ, Penn State, Exeter) remain closed/below-threshold, unchanged. WebFetch still egress-blocked; next scan 17 Sep.
